resources.string: Blocks or remaps the Netflix button on Shield remotes
Protection is on — the Netflix button is blocked
Protection is off — enable access above to start blocking
Accessibility permission required. Go to settings to enable
This app does not use, store or send any data, and runs locally on device
Then: Device Preferences → Accessibility → Netflix Button Remapper → Enable
Cancels the press so Netflix never opens
Shows an on-screen message when the button is pressed
Opens another application when the button is pressed
If the target application is already open, the button press is ignored
Made by Jorge Palanca. Not affiliated
This access lets the app detect the Netflix button press so it can block or remap it. No data is collected, stored, or shared
